newsitem.title: USA: MacKenzie Investment Feb net sales.
newsitem.headline: MacKenzie Investment Feb net sales.

text.p: Mackenzie Investment Management Inc said net sales, after redemptions, of its U.S.-sold mutual funds were US$166 million in February versus US$185 million in January.
Gross sales for Ivy Funds were US$199.9 million in February versus US$221 million in January. Assets under management in U.S. funds were US$2.68 billion.

C. William Ferris, MacKenzie chief financial officer, said the overall decline could be traced to the lower number of business days in February. Average daily flows were slightly higher in February, he added.
Net sales of Canadian-sold funds were C$38.4 million, while gross sales were C$49.2 million. Total assets under management for Canadian investors were US$972 million.
Combined assets under management were US$3.65 billion as of February 28.
